name: Palette-swap variants
oneLiner: One sprite, many looks without new art: the module finds the sprite's colour ramps (clothing, body, skin, steel, outline) and maps them dark-to-light onto new ramps, giving team colours (blue, red, green, yellow), elite and rare foes, poison, stone, frozen, a pulsing low-HP tint and a greyed 'already acted' look, combinable with '+'. Every (sprite, variant) is built once and cached; the game only changes the image it passes to drawImage.
fits: tactics / strategy RPG (team colours, greyed after acting)
turn-based RPG battle (elite foes, status tints, low HP)
action RPG and roguelike (elite / rare enemies, status effects)
multiplayer or versus games with per-player colours
notFor: art that is drawn fresh every frame with no stable sprite object (bake it first)
photographic or heavily textured sprites (hundreds of colours: ramps are guessed from 5-bit buckets and look flatter)
looks that need new shapes (armour pieces, crowns): that is new art, not a palette

needs: the sprite the game already draws, as a long-lived canvas, loaded image or palette-indexed string sprite {rows, pal}
state that names the look: side or team, acted flag, elite flag, status, HP
the draw call of each sprite (the image argument is swapped)
optional: a fixed step clock (update(ms)) for the low-HP pulse
provides: a cached canvas per (sprite, variant) to draw instead of the sprite
detected colour ramps per sprite (ramps(sprite)) and explicit ramp mapping (setRamps)

params.label: Which sprites get which looks (required; the designer's words)
params.default: units: team colour per side (player blue, enemy red); a unit that has already acted this turn: greyed; units below a quarter of their HP: low-HP pulse

params.label: Keep skin-like colours out of team swaps
Ramps a team / elite swap recolours

params.uses: units: team colour per side (player blue, enemy red); a unit that has acted this turn: greyed
the strongest foe of the last wave: elite; poisoned or cursed units: poison tint until it ends; heroes below a quarter HP: low-HP pulse
enemies the game already marks as rare, or the first foe of every third wave (by wave number, no new roll): rare

assets: module/palette-swap.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_PaletteSwap): ramp detection, 13 hand-picked target ramps, variant chains, cache, low-HP pulse, string-sprite baking, ramp inspector
